capabilities: Insert a dynamic block that scans the vault and displays all lines matching a chosen tag
Insert a static numbered list of matching lines grouped by source file
Edit or delete the pulled lines freely in the static list mode
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not auto-assign tags; it pulls in lines that already contain a chosen tag.
extras: The README asks readers for donations via a buy-me-a-coffee link and invites issues or PRs; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's tag views and search point you to matching notes but don't collect the actual tagged lines into a note you can read or edit.
summary: Tag-line aggregator that pulls lines containing a chosen tag into a dynamic vault-scanning block or a static editable list in a note.
